diagnosis.detail: The real engine exposes the physical PlayLand with sourceEntityId correctly, but LegalAction's generic default targetCount/minTargets is 1 even for non-target PlayLand actions. ManualPhaseTwoOpeningActionPolicy required minTargets==0 && maxTargets==0, so the real land offer was excluded and all four roles failed closed before action submission.

successor_rule: Preserve this original. Change only the opening policy's PlayLand identification to rely on kind=PlayLand, affordability and physical own-hand source identity; do not infer target cardinality from generic LegalAction defaults for this known non-target action. Re-pin changed source/test/workflow and do not rerun this original unchanged.
